summary: Sandbach United are gearing up for an exciting 2026/27 season with just one week until kick-off, having bolstered their squad with several new signings and one returning player. The Ramblers showed some promising football in a recent friendly against St Helens, though they'll be looking to convert chances more consistently as they push for promotion. With fresh kits and new faces on board, the club is actively seeking sponsorship opportunities ahead of what looks to be an ambitious campaign.
